title: Stocks Climb as Buyers Step In Despite Nvidia Woes

Lori Calvasina, Head of US Equity Strategy at RBC Capital Markets, discusses bearish sentiment in the markets and compressed equity valuations. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Agnellis’ CNH Plans Future Exit From Construction Equipment

title: Europe’s No. 1 Pension Manager Ends Active Equities Strategy

title: Wall Street Sticks With AI Playbook After Historic Tech Unwind
summary: Hedge funds dumped technology stocks at one of the fastest paces on record last week, and the momentum crash that followed was the biggest in about 40 years. Even so, few on Wall Street are ready to call time on the AI boom.

title: US Natural Gas Jumps as Cooler Forecasts Trigger Short Covering
summary: US natural gas futures rose as much as 5.8% after forecasts shifted over the weekend to show substantially cooler weather across the Atlantic seaboard. Cooler outlooks signal higher demand for the furnace fuel as the winter heating season gets underway.

title: Fox Holds Investor Calls Before Planned Bond Sale for Roku Deal
summary: Fox Corp. is holding investor calls on Monday ahead of an expected multipart sale of bonds to help fund its cash-and-stock acquisition of Roku Inc.

title: Peloton Taps Junk-Bond Market for First Time in Refinancing Deal
summary: Peloton Interactive Inc. is tapping the junk-bond market for the first time, looking to raise about $600 million from a new offering.

title: Anthropic IPO’s Moment of Truth Nears as Waiting Period Expires
summary: Anthropic PBC can begin formally marketing its much-anticipated IPO as early as Tuesday, enabling it to make the case to investors that now is the right time to go public despite last week’s swoon in artificial intelligence-related stocks.
